generation: Speedmax CFR / CF SLX (gen 6, MY2027, launched July 2026)
identify: Closed one-piece 'AeroShield' cockpit on a cockpit post that slides into the head tube and clamps like a seatpost; AeroModule box/reservoir between the forearms; four sizes S–XL, no XS/650b. Gen 5 (2021–2025) has a bolt-on base bar on a stacked spacer column instead.

cockpit.steerer: Proprietary: the cockpit post inserts into the head tube (no conventional stem/steerer clamp)
cockpit.stem: No separate stem; the AeroShield sits on a Canyon cockpit post in Short, Long or X-Long length, preset at the factory from Canyon's PPS 2.0 / AeroID inputs.
cockpit.stack_system: Stepless along the post in three bands, 105 mm total: Low 0–35 mm (all sizes); Mid 35–70 (S), 30–70 (M), 25–70 (L), 20–70 (XL); High 70–105 (S), 65–105 (M), 60–105 (L), 55–105 (XL). Canyon gives no absolute pad-height numbers.
cockpit.reach_system: Each post length (Short, Long, X-Long) gives 50 mm of stepless fore-aft travel, 150 mm across all three; standard AeroShield extension length 70 mm stepless.
cockpit.angle_system: Pad tilt 0–20° stepless on a 10° (standard AeroShield) or 20° (AeroShield Pro) base: Short 10–30°, Long 10–40°, X-Long 20–40° (Pro only).
cockpit.notes: Standard AeroShield pad width stepless 200–275 mm (S/M) or 225–300 mm (L/XL); AeroShield Pro comes in fixed shells. A fitter with 15+ fitted customers says Canyon's tool outputs a parts list but not how much adjustment is left, so where a rider sits in the range is unknown. Canyon told owners (July 2026 e-mail, per posters) that untested third-party reach extenders/adapters are not approved and may void the warranty; no aftermarket cockpit adapter for gen 6 was found.

effect.text: Changing post length shifts the 50 mm reach window: Short→Long or Long→X-Long moves it one band, 150 mm of reach across all three posts. X-Long needs the AeroShield Pro.

evidence.says: Launch article from Canyon briefing: three posts, 50 mm stepless each, 150 mm total; Short 10–30°, Long 10–40°, X-Long 20–40° (Pro only).
Fitter: Canyon makes three versions, each with 50 mm of reach to play with; you must know which one you need when ordering.

parts.needs: Chosen at order via PPS 2.0; whether posts are sold separately later, and at what price, is not published.

effect.text: Pro base tilt is 20° vs 10° on the standard AeroShield (so up to 40° pad tilt) and it unlocks the X-Long post; fixed-width shells chosen from forearm length/width; ~300 g lighter.

evidence.says: AeroShield Pro: +EUR 500 / +USD 500 upgrade, seven fixed shells, not available on the CF SLX 7.
Canyon press release: AeroShield Pro claimed ~3 W faster and 300 g lighter than the standard AeroShield.

parts.needs: Not offered on the CF SLX 7. An owner says the Pro shipped without end plugs shown in Canyon's images.

parts.model: Gen-5 (2021–2025) cockpit, spacers and gen-5 aftermarket adapters

effect.text: Angle Fitting Kit, Monogrip, Radsport Ibert/AeroCoach/TriRig/Vision gen-5 adapters and the old base bar.

parts.reason_incompatible: Canyon France told an owner there is no front-end compatibility between the previous and the new Speedmax; gen 6 has no spacer column or base-bar clamp for those parts.

evidence.says: Owner reports Canyon France by phone: no compatibility of the front end between old and new generation.
Gen 6 replaces gen 5's bolt-on aerobar with the closed AeroShield on a head-tube post.

parts.model: AeroShield Pro on the Speedmax CF SLX 7

effect.text: The Pro cockpit (and with it the X-Long post and 20° base tilt) on the entry SLX 7.

parts.reason_incompatible: Canyon does not offer the AeroShield Pro on the CF SLX 7 (Slowtwitch launch report).

evidence.says: AeroShield Pro not available on the SLX 7; start at the SLX 8 to get it.

gaps: No pad stack/reach (Pad X/Y) ranges per size published by Canyon or found elsewhere; only relative ranges (105 mm stack, 150 mm reach across posts). stock_range left empty.
Whether changing between Low/Mid/High stack bands needs a different part, and whether posts/AeroShields can be bought after delivery and at what price, is not published.
No aftermarket extension, adapter or pad for the gen-6 AeroShield found as of 2026-11-16 (a forum poster says some are in development).
AeroShield Pro shell widths in the Slowtwitch table look inconsistent; a forum user measured a medium Pro cockpit at 37 cm long (unverified).
Canyon US product pages showed 'coming soon' for gen 6 in Nov 2026; Canyon's own spare-part pages for posts/shells not found.
